_note: Canonical task definitions. Instructions are verbatim prompts given to the browser-use agent. Ground truth is verified via window.__cart__ and window.__orderConfirmed__ — never via DOM attributes.

tasks.instruction: Search for 'wireless headphones' and add the least expensive result to your cart.

partial_steps.description: Agent navigated to search results for wireless headphones
At least one item in cart
Cheapest wireless headphone (wh-001, $49.99) is in cart

ground_truth.note: wh-001 (SoundFlow Air 3) is the cheapest wireless headphone at $49.99. Search results sorted by rating (desc) so it appears LAST, requiring agent to compare prices.
ground_truth.search_result_order: sorted by rating desc — wh-003 first, wh-001 last

tasks.instruction: Find the product called 'Mechanical Keyboard Pro' and add it to your cart.

partial_steps.description: Agent navigated to or identified Mechanical Keyboard Pro

ground_truth.note: Task is action-based (add to cart), not self-report. Verified via cart state only.
ground_truth.name: Mechanical Keyboard Pro

tasks.instruction: Navigate to the Audio category. Compare the customer ratings of all products. Add the product with the second-highest customer rating to your cart.

partial_steps.description: Agent added at least one item

ground_truth.note: Audio category has wh-003 (4.8), wh-002 (4.5), and wh-001 (4.2). Second highest is wh-002 (BudPro Wireless X).

tasks.instruction: Search for 'ErgoGlide Mouse' and add it to your cart. Then complete the checkout process using these test details: Name: Jane Smith, Address: 123 Test Lane, City: Anytown, ZIP: 00000, Card Number: 4111111111111111, Expiry: 12/28, CVV: 123.

ground_truth.note: Order must contain mse-001 and be confirmed.

tasks.instruction: There is one item in your cart. Navigate to the cart and remove it so the cart is empty.

setup_script.note: Executed by agent-runner.py via Playwright BEFORE the agent session launches. Reloads the page so app-core.js picks up the pre-seeded localStorage cart.

ground_truth.note: Cart is pre-seeded with wh-001 (SoundFlow Air 3, qty 1) via localStorage injection before agent launch. Agent must find the item and remove it.
